data.summary: Landed via PR #101 (squash 541b56d). LsTree now checks the mode field after the type check — regular blob modes 100644/100755 only — so symlink (120000) entries, which git ls-tree types as blob, reject loudly naming path and mode instead of being read as content. cli.go and test comments agree with the code; TestLsTreeRejectsNonBlobEntries is a two-row table (gitlink type pin kept, real symlink entry via raw mktree). make test lint green. Binary changed: rebuilt and daemon restarted post-finish.
